same.reason: Same three goddesses listed twice under slightly different names.
Two spellings of Hercules's mother, both married to Amphitryon.
Same son of Belus, king in Arabia or Egypt, brother of Danaus.

different.name: Castor
different.reason: Dioscuri means both twins, Castor and Pollux, not Castor alone.

different.name: Eurytus
different.reason: Molionides are the sons of Molione, not the giant Eurytus.

different.name: Hippocoon
different.reason: Hippocoontids are his sons, a group, not him.

different.name: Ephialtes
different.reason: Aloads are Otus and Ephialtes together, not Ephialtes alone.

different.name: Dino
different.reason: Phorcides are the three sisters, not Dino alone.
